import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0107 {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) : card (A \ (A \ B)) = card (B ∩ A) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0107 {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) : card (A \ (A \ B)) = card (B ∩ A) := by
  have h1 : A \ (A \ B) = B ∩ A := by
    ext x
    split
    · intro h
      have h2 : x ∈ A := by
        exact h
      have h3 : x ∉ A \ B := by
        intro h4
        have h5 : x ∈ A := by
          exact h2
        have h6 : x ∉ B := by
          exact h4
        contradiction
      exact h2
      
    · intro h
      have h2 : x ∈ B := by
        exact h
      have h3 : x ∈ A := by
        exact h
      exact h2
  exact card_eq_of_subsets h1
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0107 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0107 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
